svg.title: Option B — LibreChat on Amazon EC2
svg.desc: AWS architecture for the LibreChat Docker Compose deployment on Amazon EC2 with Amazon Bedrock access.
svg.text: Option B — LibreChat on Amazon EC2
Official LibreChat Docker Compose stack with Amazon Bedrock model access
Default VPC · Security group allows TCP 80
EC2: t3.medium · encrypted gp3 30 GiB · IMDSv2 required
